errors.evidence: This statement is factually incorrect. The orange line (at 2015 prices) has higher values than the blue line (at current prices) from 2000 to 2014. The blue line only becomes higher from 2016 onwards. Therefore, the orange line has higher values for the majority of the period, not the blue line.

The description fails to mention the intersection point of the two lines in the year 2015, where both have a value of 15.76. This is a significant feature of the chart, as it marks the point where the relationship between the two series inverts (i.e., which one has a higher value).
